quote: On May 30, 2024, Blue Owl Finance LLC ("Blue Owl Finance"), an indirect subsidiary of Blue Owl Capital Inc. (the "Company"), priced an offering of $250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 6.250% Senior Notes due 2034 (the "notes").
